published.citation: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 308, Name='V916 Aql', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 250 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic): 5500 +/- 250 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186

temperature.note: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 1.089 +/- 0.064 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
